observations.trace: Current shrub batches call ground_scatter_reach(4.5), which sets above1.5 metres, scaled by largest instance in the cell. Common hazel uses a shared deterministic specimen generated from its checked-in seed and hazel parameters; the checked-in measured envelope records max height3.0651023387908936m and authored hazel height parameter2.65m. For a singleton shrub, if the current rendered mesh actually reaches the recorded maximum, its scaled top exceeds the 1.5m scaled bound. observations.trace: prepare_meshes prepares all missing generated families before installing any of them in the retained cache. append_litter_batch returns Ok without a batch if a mesh handle is absent; caller gathers candidate anchors and counts before appending, and propagates merge errors.

observations.trace: For a2-by-2 all-TallGrass SceneGround accepted by from_samples with scale1e-20 metres, litter::spawn asks leaf_litter_proximity for its first sample. ceil(3.2/scale) exceeds isize maximum on 32- and64-bit targets and the float cast saturates. The nested inclusive ranges span -isize::MAX..=isize::MAX; even the first outer row executes 2*isize::MAX+1 inner iterations, most immediately rejected by bounds. This is symbolic source reasoning only; reaching spawn is conditional. The finite Position<Scene> constructor accepts x=1.2e9m. With the actual positive0.55m maximum separation and a nonzero maximum pair count, floor(x/0.55) cast to i32 saturates at i32::MAX. closest iterates dx=-1..=1 and forms cell_x+dx before map lookup, so dx=1 overflows with checks enabled even if the leaf list is empty. No function or Rust arithmetic was executed.
observations.remaining: Both witnesses are source-only and constrained by actual normal scene-input admission; no loop, decode, scene or capture ran.
